verdict: Ads are driving clicks, but a tracking failure is hiding every lead.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $507 was spent on Google Ads and your site received 674 sessions — but zero leads were recorded across every channel. The confirmed cause is a conversion tracking failure, not a problem with the ads or the audience: 116 clicks reached the site and none converted in the system, which is not a realistic outcome and points squarely to a broken tracking event. Repairing that event and completing an end-to-end test of the full intake stack is the immediate priority this week. Once tracking is restored, leads that are already moving through your pipeline will surface correctly, and paid campaigns can be optimised against real results.

watch_item.issue: Conversion tracking is not firing — no leads are being recorded despite real site traffic, and several planned setup milestones are overdue.
watch_item.fix: An end-to-end test of the full intake and tracking stack is underway now, with money paths and offline conversion imports targeted for completion by end of September.
